# NA Room

> Anonymous peer-support platform for people concerned about cannabis use.

NA Room connects people who want support around cannabis use with peers who
have lived experience and are willing to help. There are no accounts, no
professional credentials, and no operators — it is peer support, not a
medical, therapeutic, or emergency service, and not a marketplace for buying,
selling, or trading cannabis or any other substance.

## What it is

- No account is required — no account credentials such as email or phone
  number are needed to use the platform
- A Litecoin (LTC) wallet address is used for eligibility (balance) checks
  and to receive payment — it is not treated as an account or an identity
- When a helper opens a client's contact, the client is notified with the
  helper's platform nickname and rating; the helper, after payment, receives
  the client's Telegram or Signal contact handle. That contact handle is
  stored encrypted and available only for a limited time — there is no
  built-in chat on the platform
- Runs autonomously: no operators, no customer support, no manual review

## What it is not

- Not a medical service, and not therapy or treatment
- Not a crisis line or emergency service
- Not a marketplace for buying, selling, or trading cannabis or any
  substance — NA Room does not facilitate or encourage use

## How it works

**For clients (people seeking support):**
1. Enter a Litecoin wallet (recommended balance: $150) and describe the
   support needed — balance is only checked, never charged beyond the fee below
2. Pay $5 to publish the listing; it is visible on the public board for 24 hours
3. Reactivate for free once per day for 5 calendar days total, from the same
   wallet, with a fresh balance check each time
4. When a helper opens the contact, its Telegram or Signal nickname and
   rating appear; the client may rate the helper starting 1 hour after
   contact opens

**For helpers (people offering support):**
1. Open a real listing and enter a Litecoin wallet with at least $1,010
   before an invoice is issued
2. Pay the $10 invoice from that same wallet; the invoice is valid for 60
   minutes, and paying within the first 40 minutes is recommended
3. After payment confirms, at least $1,000 must remain on the wallet — the
   contact (Telegram or Signal) then opens and stays available for 24 hours
4. The helper may rate the client starting 1 hour after the contact opens;
   the rating window closes 24 hours after the contact first opened

**Informer (optional notifications, not a chat and not a helper signup):**
A Litecoin wallet with at least $1,000 can subscribe to Telegram
notifications for new listings in one city. It only sends notifications —
it does not open contacts or register anyone as a helper.

## Fees

- Client: $5 to publish a listing
- Helper: $10 to open a contact

## Currency

Litecoin (LTC) only during the current launch.

## Languages

English, Russian, Spanish, Georgian

## Cities

Buenos Aires, São Paulo, Nha Trang, Da Nang, Tbilisi, Batumi, Almaty,
Yerevan, Moscow, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Antalya, Bali

## Public pages (indexed)

- /v2/how-it-works — how the platform works, in each supported language
- /v2/board/{city} — browse listings by city (replace {city} with a slug above)

## Private pages (not indexed, not crawled)

- /v2/new — post a listing (requires wallet verification)
- /v2/restore — return to an existing listing with its recovery code
- /v2/informer — notification sign-up
- /v2/listing/{id} — listing detail and contact-purchase flow
- /v2/helper/purchase, /v2/helper/purchases — helper contact-purchase flow
- /api/* — application programming interface, not a page

## Source

Open source: https://github.com/naroomer/naroom

## Emergency

NA Room is not an emergency service. If you or someone else is in immediate
danger, contact local emergency services directly.
